class.name: JRPGScriptCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: runs a line of the author's own code.
class.description: Runs [member script_text], a Godot [Expression], for what it does, with the game state as [code]state[/code] and the interpreter as [code]interpreter[/code]: [code]state.set_variable(3, state.get_gold() / 2)[/code]. Unlike formulas it may call any method: it is the author's own code, and keeping it deterministic is the author's part. A text that does not parse, or an error while it runs, is warned about once. Authority: server.
